name: away-autopilot
description: 用户离开 5 分钟未回复待确认的问题时，提示模型自行决定；模型可调用工具暂停自动推进。

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before the nudge
idleMinutes.description: Minutes without a reply from the user before a waiting turn is nudged. Decimals are allowed; 0.5 to 240. Out-of-range or invalid values fall back to the default.

maxAutoNudges.title: Auto-nudges per away stretch
maxAutoNudges.description: How many times one away stretch may nudge the model on its own. 0 turns automatic progress off; 0 to 50. Out-of-range or invalid values fall back to the default.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs at all. When false: no pause tool, no system prompt section, no timer.
